text: The sword and the shield!\nThe legends really were true![VAR 0114(0005)]
That settles it!\nI’m taking the shield![VAR 0114(0005)]
That settles it!\nI’m taking the sword![VAR 0114(0005)]

Though...wow, would you look at the state
of this thing?\c
It seems like it might fall to pieces if you so much
as look at it funny.\c
I don’t know if these rusty old things will really
be able to stop the Darkest Day, but...\c
Well, I guess it can’t hurt to have them along!
Let’s hope they bring us some good luck![VAR 0114(0005)]
